title: Withdrawal Allowance, Counted Channels and Excess Withdrawal Fees
content:
Accounts of Savings & Money Market Accounts carry a per-cycle allowance of counted withdrawals. The clauses below state when a withdrawal is paid, when it counts against that allowance, and what it is charged.

### 1. When a withdrawal is paid

A withdrawal is paid only from an account whose status is active or dormant. It is paid only when its amount does not exceed the current balance: a withdrawal that would take the balance below zero is declined and never posts. The one exception is an overdraft protection transfer, which the Personal Checking charter makes only when the savings balance covers it in full.

### 2. When a withdrawal counts

Withdrawals made in person at a branch and withdrawals at an ATM never count toward the allowance. Every other withdrawal counts when its channel is among the tier's counted channels, and an overdraft protection transfer counts when the tier's parameter for such transfers reads yes. Counted withdrawals are numbered in posting order through the statement cycle.

### 3. What a counted withdrawal beyond the allowance costs

Each counted withdrawal beyond the tier's free allowance incurs the tier's excess withdrawal fee, written as a fee entry carrying the excess withdrawal fee code whose source item is that withdrawal. Fees are charged in that order until the count of excess withdrawal fees in the cycle reaches the tier's cap on such fees, after which further counted withdrawals in the cycle are paid without a fee. A tier whose free allowance reads unlimited never charges the fee. Each withdrawal carries at most one excess withdrawal fee. The tier used is the one recorded on the account on the withdrawal's posting date.

### 4. Wire charges

An outgoing wire also incurs the tier's outgoing domestic wire fee, written with the wire out fee code, and an incoming wire credited to the account incurs the tier's incoming wire fee, written with the incoming wire fee code. A fee of 0.00 USD writes no entry.

### 5. Daily limits

Daily limits apply per calendar day in Eastern Time. ATM cash is paid within the tier's ATM daily withdrawal limit, and only on a tier whose ATM card access reads yes. Online and mobile transfers out are paid within the tier's online transfer daily limit. Money market checks are paid only on a tier whose check writing parameter reads yes. A request beyond the applicable limit is declined and never posts.

### Illustration of the counting

Take a hypothetical account whose tier allows 6 free counted withdrawals in a cycle and caps excess withdrawal fees at 6 in a cycle. Counted withdrawals numbered 1 through 6 in the cycle carry no fee. The 7th counted withdrawal carries the tier's excess withdrawal fee, and so on, until 6 such fees stand in that cycle; every counted withdrawal after that is paid without a fee. A branch cash withdrawal taken between them is not numbered at all, because branch withdrawals never count.
